name: עַזְמָוֶת
gloss: death is strong; or strong as death
summary: Borne by four men, all of Benjamin or of David's time: Azmaveth the Barhumite, one of David's thirty mighty men; a descendant of Saul through Jonathan, son of Jehoaddah; the father of Jeziel and Pelet, Benjamite slingers who came to David at Ziklag; and Azmaveth son of Adiel, who was over the king's treasuries. It is also the name of a village near Jerusalem (Ezr 2:24; Neh 12:29, Beth-azmaveth in Neh 7:28). The name is עַז “strong” joined to מָוֶת “death”; scripture does not explain it, but the Song has the same two words together: “love is strong as death (עַזָּה כַמָּוֶת)”.

evidence.note: Among the thirty: “עַזְמָוֶת the Barhumite”; so 1Ch 11:33, “the Baharumite”.
Of Saul's line: “Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth and עַזְמָוֶת and Zimri”; so 1Ch 9:42.
“Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of עַזְמָוֶת”, of Saul's brothers of Benjamin.
“Over the king's treasuries was עַזְמָוֶת the son of Adiel.”
The name's two words together: “כִּי־עַזָּה כַמָּוֶת אַהֲבָה, for love is strong as death.”
The place: “from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth”.

note: The first element is of the root עזז, which has no entry yet; the name is filed here under its second element. The key p.bx.at is the personal name; the place is p.bx.au (filed under בית) and is not claimed. TIPNR splits the bearers into four people; whether the father of Jeziel and Pelet (1Ch 12:3) is the same man as the Barhumite of the thirty is not said.
